capabilities.description: Move the Piper end-effector site (ee_site) to a specified world-frame Cartesian position. Single terminal effect; no object interaction assumed.
capabilities.effect: ee_site reaches target_position within tolerance at end of motion.
preconditions: target_position is within the Piper reachable workspace.
No joint is at a hard limit that would prevent IK convergence.
invariants: joint1..joint6 remain within their ctrlrange throughout motion.
joint7 (gripper) state is not modified by this capability.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Returns False and holds last joint configuration if IK fails or target is unreachable.

criteria.metric: Euclidean distance from ee_site to target_position at terminal state
criteria.rationale: Adapted from Meta-World sawyer_reach_v3 success criterion: reach_dist <= 0.05 m (actual_study: metaworld/envs/sawyer_reach_v3.py lines 74-98).

source_refs.specific_reference: metaworld/envs/sawyer_reach_v3.py, evaluate_state, lines 74-98: success is reach_dist <= 0.05.

capabilities.description: Set the Piper gripper slide-position (joint7 actuator 'gripper') to a specified opening in metres. joint8 follows passively via equality constraint joint8 = -joint7.
capabilities.effect: joint7 reaches target_opening within tolerance; joint8 mirrors it.
preconditions: Arm is in a stable configuration (not mid-motion).
invariants: joint8 = -joint7 via equality constraint at all times.
Arm joint positions (joint1-joint6) are not modified.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Clamps target_opening to [0.0, 0.035] and applies clamped value; logs warning.

criteria.metric: Absolute error of joint7 position from target_opening at terminal state
criteria.rationale: proposed: 3 mm tolerance on a 35 mm travel slide gripper (~8.6% of full range), consistent with position-controlled actuator settling.

source_refs.specific_reference: Proposed 3 mm tolerance on joint7 slide position (35 mm range); no direct Meta-World gripper position criterion exists.

capabilities.description: Set Piper joint6 (wrist roll) to a specified angle in radians while holding all other arm joints fixed.
preconditions: target_angle is within joint6 ctrlrange [-3.14, 3.14] rad.
Arm is in a stable configuration.
invariants: joint1-joint5 positions are not modified by this capability.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Clamps target_angle to ctrlrange and applies clamped value; logs warning.

criteria.metric: Absolute error of joint6 position from target_angle at terminal state
criteria.rationale: proposed: 0.05 rad (~2.9 deg) wrist-roll positioning tolerance for grasp alignment tasks (pick-place, bin-picking).

source_refs.specific_reference: Proposed 0.05 rad tolerance on joint6 wrist-roll; derived from grasp alignment requirements in mw_pick_place and mw_bin_picking.

capabilities.description: Move ee_site through an ordered sequence of up to four world-frame Cartesian waypoints. Each waypoint is visited in order before proceeding to the next.
capabilities.effect: ee_site visits waypoint_1, then waypoint_2 (if provided), then waypoint_3 (if provided), then waypoint_4 (if provided) in order.
preconditions: All provided waypoints are within the Piper reachable workspace.
Waypoints are provided in the order they must be visited.
invariants: Waypoints are visited strictly in order: waypoint_1 before waypoint_2 before waypoint_3 before waypoint_4.
Gripper state is not modified by this capability.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Stops at the last successfully reached waypoint and returns False if any waypoint is unreachable.

criteria.metric: Ordered trajectory matching: ee_site visits all provided waypoints in order; terminal error to final waypoint
criteria.rationale: proposed: 0.05 m terminal error at final waypoint, consistent with Meta-World reach/push/pick-place thresholds. Ordered traversal required for wall-routing tasks (mw_push_wall, mw_pick_place_wall, mw_door_open, mw_faucet_open, mw_dial_turn, mw_lever_pull).

source_refs.specific_reference: metaworld/envs/sawyer_push_wall_v3.py evaluate_state and sawyer_pick_place_wall_v3.py evaluate_state: ordered routing around obstacle required before terminal placement.

capabilities.description: Move ee_site to a contact_position and then continue to a tool_target_position, maintaining contact force throughout. Used for pressing, pushing, and sweeping motions.
capabilities.effect: ee_site reaches contact_position, then moves to tool_target_position; contact normal force is generated during the displacement phase.
preconditions: contact_position and tool_target_position are within the Piper reachable workspace.
A scene object or fixture is present at or near contact_position to generate contact force.
invariants: Gripper state is not modified by this capability.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Returns False if contact_position or tool_target_position is unreachable; holds last configuration.

criteria.metric: Euclidean distance from ee_site to tool_target_position at terminal state
criteria.rationale: proposed: 0.05 m terminal ee_site error at tool_target_position, consistent with Meta-World push/button/handle/drawer thresholds.

source_refs.specific_reference: metaworld/envs/sawyer_push_v3.py evaluate_state lines 88-112; sawyer_button_press_v3.py evaluate_state lines 60-82; sawyer_handle_press_v3.py evaluate_state lines 64-86.

criteria.metric: Peak contact normal force between ee geoms and scene object during displacement phase
criteria.rationale: proposed: at least 0.5 N peak contact normal force confirms physical contact was made during the displacement. Threshold is conservative for a lightweight tabletop object.

source_refs.specific_reference: Proposed 0.5 N minimum peak contact force to confirm physical contact during push/press/sweep motions.

task_support.rationale: Direct reach: move ee_site to target_position; criterion matches source 0.05 m threshold (actual_study).
Push: contact object then displace ee to tool_target_position; source 0.05 m object-goal threshold (actual_study).
Approach phase: position ee_site at contact_position before push.
Approach and release phases: move ee_site to grasp_position and release_position.
Grasp and release: set gripper to grasp_gripper (closed) then open for release.
Wrist alignment: set joint6 to grasp_wrist_roll before grasping object.
Route around wall: ordered waypoints (grasp, lift, route_position, release_position) required (actual_study).
Grasp and release: gripper control for pick-place-wall.
Wrist alignment for grasp in pick-place-wall.
Route around wall: ordered waypoints for push-wall routing (actual_study).
Contact push phase after routing around wall.
Sweep: contact object and displace to tool_target_position; source 0.05 m object-goal threshold (actual_study).
Pull drawer: contact handle and displace to tool_target_position; source 0.03 m handle error (actual_study).
Push drawer closed: contact and displace; source 0.065 m threshold (actual_study).
Press button: contact and displace along y-axis; source 0.02 m threshold (actual_study).
Top-down press: contact and displace along z-axis; source 0.024 m threshold (actual_study).
Press handle: contact and displace; source 0.02 m threshold (actual_study).
Pull handle: contact and displace; source 0.05 m threshold (actual_study).
Door open: ordered waypoints for arc motion; source 0.08 m x-axis error (actual_study).
Contact and push/pull door handle during open motion.
Door close: ordered waypoints for arc motion around hinge.
Contact and push door to closed position; source 0.08 m threshold (actual_study).
Faucet open: ordered waypoints for rotary handle approach and turn; source 0.07 m threshold (actual_study).
Contact faucet handle and displace through rotation arc.
Dial turn: ordered waypoints for rotary contact approach and arc; source 0.07 m threshold (actual_study).
Contact dial and displace through turn arc.
Lever pull: ordered waypoints for approach, contact, and pull arc; source pi/24 rad threshold (actual_study).
Contact lever and displace through pull arc.
Peg insertion: ordered waypoints for grasp, align, route, insert; source 0.07 m weighted threshold (actual_study).
Grasp peg before insertion.
Wrist alignment for peg orientation during insertion.
Bin picking: ordered waypoints for approach, grasp, extract, place; source 0.05 m threshold (actual_study).
Grasp object in bin and release at target.
Wrist alignment for bin grasp orientation.
Pick out of hole: ordered waypoints for descent, grasp, extract, place; source 0.07 m threshold (actual_study).
Grasp object in hole and release at target.
Wrist alignment for hole grasp orientation.
